c2_closure_package.scope_note: The causal claim is scoped to the historical 128/8 path as executed here. It is not a claim about universal PyTorch behaviour.
c2_closure_package.preservation_note: The package bytes are tracked in git and marked -text so the recorded SHA-256 values, which are over raw bytes, survive checkout on either platform. At commit da7e0b5 the package was untracked and its manifest was stale: the packager had run before the final edit to C2_CAUSAL_CONDITION_ESTABLISHED.md, recording 4725 bytes for a 5854-byte file, which also invalidated the package root. Both defects were found by independent verification from a clean clone and are repaired here.

frozen_for_review.supersession_reason: At da7e0b5 the closure outputs were untracked and absent from a clean clone, the manifest and package root were stale against their own document, and the gradient gate used an underflow-prone norm test. All three are repaired.

platform_split.cuda_c2_torch_replay: WSL or native Linux GPU checkout
platform_split.note: The worktree .git indirection is a Windows path, so git commands fail from WSL against that worktree. That is an environment artifact and must not be read as a scientific failure. Clone the remote into the Linux filesystem instead.

blocker_evidence.F1B_15_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER_FINDINGS_UNR: docs/agent/F1B_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_REVIEW_20260905.md on review/f1b-independent-verifier-repair-20260905 enumerates 15 numbered findings against f1b-minimal-bridge-20260905@f0fb23c2.
blocker_evidence.F1B_10_OF_15_FINDINGS_LACK_EXECUTABLE_AT: scripts/v4/verify_f1b_minimal_bridge_independent_v1.py emits only 4 executable attack codes (G1_ACCEPTS_NONFINITE_GRADIENT, G2_ACCEPTS_ZERO_SECOND_MOMENT, G3_MEAN_MASKS_DECAY_ONLY_TENSOR, PUBLISHED_300U_EXCEEDS_FROZEN_40U_HORIZON). The remaining findings are prose-only. A C3 repair cannot be verified against a finding that has no executable attack, so the attacks must be written before the repair.
blocker_evidence.F1_QUALIFY_CURRENT_DOES_NOT_GATE_PROGRAM: qualify_current gates per-program estimability and deltas but never per-program sign. holm(p_positive) is computed in contextual_target_f1_decision_v4.py but surfaced only as protected_program_positive_holm_report_only and is absent from the gates dict. A payload with 5 of 8 protected programs having two-sided 95% CIs entirely below zero still returns qualified=True. Reproduced independently twice. Upstream of any real F1.
blocker_evidence.F1_SCIENTIFIC_CONTRACT_CHOICES_AWAIT_EXT: Pending prospective scientific contracts remain unfrozen; do not invent them.
blocker_evidence.SEALED_HOLDOUT_MEMBERSHIP_PUBLICLY_READA: results/v4/stage81a2_split_registry.csv on public main discloses which donors are in the sealed_holdout split, together with the freeze seed and assignment method. NOT a privacy or PII issue: the owner confirms all donor data was obtained from already-public databases (SEA-AD is published by the Allen Institute), so donor identifiers and pathology are already in the public domain and require no remediation. The remaining issue is narrower and purely one of split concealment: a sealed holdout assumes membership is unknown until the evaluation contract is frozen, so a publicly readable membership list makes a future sealed-evaluation claim contestable regardless of whether anyone looked. Nothing to repair in git; if a sealed-holdout evaluation is proposed later, re-seal with a fresh seed and partition instead.
blocker_evidence.C2_AD_HOC_REPRODUCTION_SUPERSEDED: outputs/_private_c2_t1_forensic_20260905/C2_T1_ACCUMULATION_FORENSIC.json has no preserved config or invocation and is contradicted by two specified reconstructions. Superseded, not a lead. The Historian objection that the QKV matrix contradicted the checkpoints is reopened.
blocker_evidence.PHASE_E_GRADIENT_CHECK_IS_BLIND_TO_ZERO: component_gradient_report counts only missing and nonfinite gradients, never zero, so it passed while all 48 mandatory tensors were exactly zero. A repaired fail-closed gate exists at scripts/v4/c2_mandatory_gradient_gate_v1.py. Independent verification found that its first form used a gradient norm, which squares and so underflowed a lone fp32 subnormal to exactly zero, misclassifying 48 live tensors as dead; it now tests emptiness exactly with any(grad != 0) and finiteness separately. Eleven adversarial tests pass, including a live-tensor test in the real gradient dtype and two replaying preserved K0 and K1 bytes. NOT YET ADOPTED by any successor training path, which is what would close this.
blocker_evidence.C2_DEEP_KERNEL_MECHANISM_OPEN: Necessity and sufficiency are established at the code-condition level: disabling autocast only around the backward call restores all 48 tensors at 128/8 with all nine frozen criteria met, while the historical arm still gives 48/48 dead. Why the collapse is to EXACT zero rather than merely inaccurate values is unresolved. The autocast weight cache (I1) and allow_fp16_reduced_precision_reduction (J1) were both tested and refuted.
blocker_evidence.C2_PRODUCTION_SAFE_REWRITE_NOT_RUN: The production_safe variant currently accumulates every scaled loss and drains the backwards after the autocast block, holding 64 live graphs at 128/8, and will exhaust memory. The autocast region must move inside the view loop to preserve per-view accumulation. Not yet repaired, not yet run, no 128/8 regression.
blocker_evidence.DEC013_SUPERSESSION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_: The DEC-013 characterisation of T1 as having valid mechanics is not defensible in the parameter-wise sense. The historical biological outcome stands: T1 did not qualify biology at u205. Supersession must follow independent C2 verification, not precede it.
blocker_evidence.C2_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_PENDING: The repaired candidate has NOT been independently certified. The same agent implemented C2 and ran the verification, so the no-self-certification requirement is unmet. The verification found three real defects and returned each for repair - untracked closure outputs, a stale manifest and root, and a gradient gate whose norm-based zero test underflowed a lone fp32 subnormal and misclassified 48 live tensors as dead - and all three are repaired here. Those findings are implementation feedback, not certification. Only a separate reviewer starting from a fresh clone of the exact frozen remote commit may return PASS_C2_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION, binding it to the commit SHA, the package root, the verifier source digest and the verifier result root. Until then the project state is not C2_CLOSED.

continuity_defects_repaired_by_claude_co.DOCUMENTED_TAKEOVER_COMMAND_COULD_NOT_PA: CLAUDE.md instructed 'validate --repo . --worktree .' but the checkpoint records the canonical repo path by design, so the first takeover step always raised a spurious REPO_PATH_MISMATCH. Added work_checkpoint.resolve_canonical_repo(), made --repo optional and auto-resolved via 'git rev-parse --git-common-dir', and corrected CLAUDE.md. No agent now hardcodes the canonical path.
continuity_defects_repaired_by_claude_co.TEST_RUN_INVALIDATED_ITS_OWN_CHECKPOINT: The handoff protocol requires running focused tests, but the pytest basetemp '.pytest_tmp_peer_handoff/' was untracked and not ignored, so running the tests produced UNTRACKED_FILES_MISMATCH and broke checkpoint validation. Added it to .gitignore; _git_snapshot uses --exclude-standard so the loop is now closed.
continuity_defects_repaired_by_claude_co.CODEX_ACCEPTANCE_TEST_LEFT_UNCOMMITTED_A: test_codex_claude_codex_provenance_handoff_preserves_authority_and_action is the acceptance criterion for round-trip takeover. It passes but was neither committed nor declared in allowed_tracked_modifications. Now declared, pending owner approval to commit.
continuity_defects_repaired_by_claude_co.PEER_CONSULTATION_PUBLISHED_ACCOUNT_IDEN: scripts/agent/claude_peer_bridge.py captured the full 'claude auth status --json' output into a committed provenance artifact. Its _SENSITIVE_KEY denylist did not cover email, orgId, orgName or projectsDirectory, so the committed docs/agent/peer_consultations/claude_smoke_20260905/CLAUDE_PEER_CONSULTATION.json carried account identity and the local username toward a public repository. Replaced the denylist with an allowlist (_AUTH_SUMMARY_KEYS), added _redact_user_paths, widened the denylist, removed the artifact, and purged it from unpushed branch history before first push. Covered by test_published_consultation_carries_no_account_identity_or_username.
